tutorial.trickDisplay: This is the current trick. You must follow the led suit, and you must overtrump when trump is led.
tutorial.playerHand: This is your hand. Click a playable card to select it.
tutorial.playButton: Once a card is selected, play it with this button. Klaverjas has no declarations — the only action is playing a card.
tutorial.info: J(trump)=20, 9(trump)=14, A=11, 10=10, K=4, Q=3, J=2. Runs and marriages earn Roem (bonus). Team A (seats 0 & 2) vs Team B (seats 1 & 3) fight over card points + Roem; the first team to reach the target points wins.
tutorial.resetButton: Use the reset button to start a new game.
